principle: Lifecycle answers WHERE a mission is. Method profile answers HOW the next bounded work is performed.

supervisor.rule: DMAIC does not force a code change; CONTROL may legitimately conclude HOLD, RETURN, DEFER, or CLOSE.

dispatcher.rule: The star denotes profile selection. 3P* is not itself a lifecycle and does not imply MIP admission.

3PC.name: PREPARE_PROVE_COMMIT
use_when: bounded implementation or control change is admitted

stage_rules.MODERNIZE: Admit only for a measured defect, friction, obsolescence, or maintainability/control gap in an existing mechanism.
stage_rules.INNOVATE: Admit only when a genuinely new capability is justified by the mission objective or measured gap.
stage_rules.PERPETUATE: Admit after useful behavior is proven enough to institutionalize through controls, docs, telemetry, handover, or regression protection.

mip.valid_noop: A stage may be NONE_NOT_ADMITTED with a reason. MIP is not a mandatory three-stage mutation.

historical_compatibility.reinterpretation: Existing receipts retain their historical meaning. New controls treat them as method executions under the broader Mission Control operating model.

g3p_envelope.name: GOVERNED_THREE_PULSE_WAVE
g3p_envelope.source_requirement: Pin baseline N by exact repository/mission/wave identity, source SHA, timestamp, scope, previous receipt; no assumed former or current main.

pulses.name: PULSE-1
pulses.aim: Measure and remove highest-leverage observed first-red, or classify HOLD with evidence.

pulses.name: PULSE-2
pulses.aim: Use N+1 actuals; expand qualifying coverage/telemetry or disjoint repair; record forecast before execution.

pulses.name: PULSE-3
pulses.aim: Integrate only source-authorized disjoint results, verify exact head/negative controls, publish complete ledger and residuals.

g3p_envelope.credit_rule: A pulse ordinal advances on a dated, source-bound terminal receipt including PASS/HOLD/DEFER; this does not itself advance engineering acceptance or prove a code change.
g3p_envelope.continuation: After a local lane HOLD, pivot to an independent safe ready lane if source-bound priorities allow; never alter owners' branch rules to force progress.
g3p_envelope.major_blocker: Stop when all safe next actions require unauthorized mutation, unreconciled source head, security/governance waiver, missing tool/permission, destructive side effect or mutually contradictory evidence.
g3p_envelope.completion: Return complete observed N to N+3 report for exactly 3 terminal evidenced pulses; if global blocker stops earlier, report partial frontier and the untouched remaining ordinals as NOT_RUN.
g3p_envelope.execution_scope: One invocation and available authenticated runners; no deferred/background completion unless a separately authorized scheduled task exists.
